note: The Tool Lab registry — every tool the family has actually tested, with an honest status and a rating for OUR use case. 'blocked' entries are the memory that stops us re-trying dead ends (the 'record what doesn't work' rule). Validate with: node tools/tool-lab.js

status.partial: works but needs a one-time setup / user step before it fully fires
status.blocked: cannot run from this cloud sandbox (permission stream closes, network policy, or integration scope) — do NOT keep retrying; run on the user's machine / n8n

legend.rating: 0-5 stars, for the AI Family use-case (not a universal score)

tools.name: Tavily search/research
tools.note: Fast, current, sourced. Our default for anything time-sensitive (prices, model versions, news).
tools.lesson: Favor for cross-checking facts before stating them.

tools.name: Hugging Face Hub + Spaces search
tools.note: whoami + hub_repo_search + space_search all returned live data (authed as kingtut369). Found the voice shortlist.
tools.lesson: Tag filters can over-constrain and return empty — search by query first, then filter.

tools.name: Notion (create-database / pages / update-page)
tools.note: Built the family dashboard + Quick Reference. Reliable.
tools.lesson: create-pages MAKES new pages, it does not edit — use update-page to edit, or you get duplicates.

tools.name: Lovable create_project
tools.note: Spun up a project for the brand site. Good for full-stack React/Tailwind apps.
tools.lesson: Include framework/rendering preferences in the initial message — no stack selector.

tools.name: Zapier enable/execute actions
tools.note: Enabled + executed actions. The bridge to 9,000+ apps.
tools.lesson: Always list_enabled first; discover then enable if missing.

tools.name: Zapier YouTube upload_video
tools.lesson: Needs a one-time YouTube auth in Zapier AND a rendered video FILE — both on the user's side. Don't mark 'posted' without a returned video ID.

tools.name: Web Speech API narration
tools.note: Powers the in-page narration on every house-style page; AUDIO[] hook swaps in ElevenLabs/IndexTTS-2 clips.
tools.lesson: Free + zero-dep for drafts; swap real clips in for the final cut to kill the robotic sound.

tools.name: Descript
tools.note: list_projects returned cleanly (authed). Text-based video editing, captions, transcript export, publish — reachable from the sandbox.
tools.lesson: Unlike render tools, Descript is NOT blocked here — use it for the edit/caption/publish step of the video pipeline.

tools.name: Wolfram Alpha
tools.note: Failed: 'permission stream closed before response received' — same approval-gate failure as the render tools.
tools.lesson: Approval-gated MCP tools that need an interactive grant close their stream in this sandbox. Don't retry; note it and move on.

tools.name: Invideo generate-video-from-script
tools.lesson: Render runs on the user's machine / n8n. Stage the render order; fire where the tool is healthy.

tools.name: HeyGen avatar video
tools.lesson: Avatar render is a local/n8n job, not a sandbox job.

tools.name: GitHub create_repository
tools.note: 403 'Resource not accessible by integration' — MCP scope is the single allowed repo only.
tools.lesson: Don't try to create new repos; stage new projects as a self-contained folder in the allowed repo.

tools.name: Discord webhook (from sandbox)
tools.note: Network policy: 403 to discord.com from this cloud sandbox.
tools.lesson: Webhook is active on the user's machine — run scripts/discord-post.js locally / via n8n with FAMILY_DISCORD_WEBHOOK.
